lessons.title: Language: Mixed Conditionals
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Language: Mixed Conditionals.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK 12.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn ôn thi THPT & ĐGNL.

concepts.definition: Conditionals where the time of the if-clause is different from the time of the main clause. Common mix: Past condition (Type 3: If + had V3) with Present result (Type 2: would + V-base).
concepts.example: If I had practiced English regularly during high school, I would be completely confident in international communication today.
concepts.essence: Connecting past decisions with enduring present reality and identity.

concepts.definition: The ongoing, voluntary, and self-motivated pursuit of knowledge for either personal or professional reasons throughout life.
concepts.example: Professionals enrolling in evening coding bootcamps to transition into data science.
concepts.essence: Essential survival mindset in an era of rapid technological disruption.

rules.statement: Mixed Conditional Type 3 condition with Type 2 result
rules.meaning: If + S + had (not) + V3/ed [past action], S + would/could (not) + V-base [present state/consequence].
rules.example: If she had accepted that scholarship last year, she would be studying in Canada now.

workedExamples.prompt: Combine using a mixed conditional: 'He didn't learn computer programming in college. Now he is unable to apply for this software engineer position.'
steps: Step 1: Past condition: He didn't learn -> If he had learned computer programming in college.
Step 2: Present consequence: He cannot apply -> he would be able to apply for this software engineer position now.
Step 3: Combine: If he had learned computer programming in college, he would be able to apply for this software engineer position now.
workedExamples.answer: If he had learned computer programming in college, he would be able to apply for this software engineer position now.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using 'would have V3' in both clauses: *If he would have studied, he would have...*
commonMistakes.why: The if-clause never contains 'would'; use Past Perfect (had studied) in the if-clause.
